text.en:
The following subdivisions known as Carmencita, Paramount, Admiral Park, Pelayo, Aristocrat,
Doña Purisima and Golden Gate in Barangay Talon in the Municipality of Las Piñas, Metro Manila, is hereby
detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and independent barangay which is
created to be known as Barangay Talon Tres without affecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother
barangay Talon.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays shall be applicable to barangay Talon Tres.

The present elective barangay officials of Barangay Talon shall continue to perform their duties
as such officials in the newly created Barangay Talon Tres until the barangay officials of said barangay shall
have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their successors shall
have been elected in the regular elections for barangay officials following the issuance of this Decree and shall
have qualified unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and employees
as may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel of Barangay Talon Tres shall be
appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Barangay Talon Tres in the
obligations, funds, assets and other property of Barangay Talon shall be transferred by the President to the
newly created barangay upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or part of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations, inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-eight.
